maddeler.e:
تخاصمت (form VI)
# تَخَاصَمْتُ (taḵāṣamtu) /ta.xaː.sˤam.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَخَاصَمَ (taḵāṣama)
# تَخَاصَمْتَ (taḵāṣamta) /ta.xaː.sˤam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَخَاصَمَ (taḵāṣama)
# تَخَاصَمْتِ (taḵāṣamti) /ta.xaː.sˤam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَخَاصَمَ (taḵāṣama)
# تَخَاصَمَتْ (taḵāṣamat) /ta.xaː.sˤa.mat/: third-person
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
